name: Hime no Gosan Tainai Monster Kisei Hen
original_name: 姫の誤算 胎内モンスター寄生編
source:
Princess Angelina joined the Horny Exotic Alien Race Termination (HEART) Squadron but during her return she was assailed and separated from the team.

Lost in the forests of the monsters she was trying to kill, the princess is stripped of all safety...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ066494?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
